Title: Azure IoT Verified telemetry is now in public preview

Body.Content:
The Verified Telemetry Dependable IoT SDK has two modules:

  • Core library, providing functions to collect and validate fingerprints.
  • IoT library, providing functions to enable sending of verified telemetry from the device to the cloud using MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport), NX_client or any custom communication implementation.

Learn more.
